draft.summary: Determine how many days refunds take to reach the card
draft.description:
## Context
Type: Spike (created as Task; this Jira project has no Spike type).

Proposed owner (from the meeting): Andrés Gil.

Laura asked how long the refund takes to reach the card. Andrés said the time depends on the payment provider and is currently unknown. Ricardo requested a number of days to tell customers.

## Question and Deliverable
Determine how many days a refund takes to reach the card by asking the payment provider. Deliverable: the provider answer reported back so Finance can communicate the refund timeframe to customers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Provider answer reported** (Happy path) — Andrés Gil has asked the payment provider about refund settlement time. Expected: the provider answer about how many days a refund takes to reach the card is reported back for customer communication.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Open question (Andrés Gil): the payment provider refund settlement time is unknown. Do not promise a number of days until the provider answers. No investigation deadline was assigned.

## Completion Checklist
- [ ] Question answered.
- [ ] Findings documented.
- [ ] Decision or recommendation recorded.
- [ ] Follow-up tickets created, if applicable.

Pending — to be linked as it becomes available.
